en.headline: Leung Yu-hong takes historic Asian Games sanda silver
en.dek: The 21-year-old world champion lost the men's 60kg final to China's Tang Sishuo, giving Hong Kong its best Asian Games result in the discipline.
body: Hong Kong wushu fighter Leung Yu-hong won silver in the men's 60-kilogram sanda final at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Thursday, the city's best result in the event at the Games.

Leung, making his Asian Games debut, faced China's Tang Sishuo, the reigning National Games champion. RTHK reported that the pair traded attacks from the opening exchanges. Tang repeatedly tried to throw Leung, who lost the first round 0-5, then was stopped in the second by an advantage victory.

The 21-year-old is a World Wushu Championships and Sanda World Cup gold medallist and a student at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. He had reached the final on Wednesday by beating Indonesia's Bintang Reindra Nada Guitara 2-1 after dropping the first round.
Chan Tsz-ching took bronze in the women's 52-kilogram class on Wednesday. Together the pair gave Hong Kong its first Asian Games sanda medals, one silver and one bronze.

zh.headline: 梁宇航亞運散打60公斤級摘銀 港隊項目最佳
zh.dek: 21歲世界冠軍周四決賽不敵國家隊唐思碩，寫下港隊亞運散打歷來最佳成績。
body: 港隊散打代表梁宇航周四在愛知・名古屋亞運會男子60公斤級決賽不敵國家隊唐思碩，取得銀牌，創出港隊在這個項目歷來於亞運的最佳成績。
首度出戰亞運即闞決賽的梁宇航，面對應屆全運會冠軍唐思碩。香港電台報道，兩人開局已互相搶攻，唐思碩多次嘗試將梁宇航摔倒，首局梁宇航較被動，以0比5先失一局，第二局被對手以優勢勝利擊倒。
現年21歲的梁宇航是世界武術錦標賽及散打世界盃金牌得主，就讀香港理工大學。他周三準決賽以2比1擊敗印尼選手，當時亦是先失一局後反勝。
陳紫晴周三已在女子52公斤級取得銅牌。連同梁宇航的銀牌，港隊今屆亞運散打項目合共1銀1銅，亦是港隊首次在亞運散打踏上頒獎台。
